# OM-3 1.1 in om-emu: Caduceus v0.30.4-alpha to v0.40.2 pass the v0.30.3 flow

om-emu's maintainers report that eight Caduceus for OM-3 releases, from v0.30.4-alpha to v0.40.2, each pass the scripted lab flow pinned for v0.30.3, with no regression and no lab limit hit.

**emulator; reported pass; partial report; release label only.**

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md) · **Project:** [Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)

**Firmware:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Mod build:** v0.30.4-alpha to v0.40.2 (eight releases)

[Report your result](https://github.com/xulfr/om-firmware-atlas/issues/new?template=camera-report.yml&target=OM+SYSTEM+OM-3+%C2%B7+stock+firmware%3A+&package=Caduceus+for+OM-3+%C2%B7+v0.30.4-alpha+to+v0.40.2+%28eight+releases%29)

**Provenance:** upstream documentation. **Reported:** 2026-11-22. **Test date:** 2026-11-22.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

Each release's patch.json, LOOKS.BIN and CURVES.BIN, taken from its GitHub release assets and checked against the listed sha256, was pinned in om-emu's E147 lab and run through the flow pinned for v0.30.3.

- The patched image opens with no unloaded patched range.
- Films load before any half-press and at the first half-press; FILM 1, 2 and 20 carry their expected names.
- The film name and photo code reach the S2 picture on the card.
- The film is kept over a power cycle, on a blank card and with no card.

Emulator: [https://github.com/flatpanda/om-emu](https://github.com/flatpanda/om-emu), revision `6b111c6b`, model `E147`.

Stand-ins: om-emu's lab model of E147, which runs no CPU 1 and has no card timing.

## Limits and assumptions

- Emulator only, reported by om-emu's maintainers; not an Atlas run and not a camera test.
- The flow sets none of the features this range adds (crop modes, borders, grain levels, screen-info rows, WB compensation, the Firmware Version page).
- It cannot show the two camera faults the range fixes, the fast film-switch reboot (#72) and the wait behind the card (#85).
- The v0.40.3 test versions and later releases were not run.
- From v0.40-alpha on the patch also hooks the settings store's save; which feature that hook serves was not read.
